set.body: Complete the promised coherent-header automatic initialization contract before release. Evaluate the coherent world-identity candidate on coarse support and information, skip expanded capture only under an explicit frozen adequacy rule, and retain identity as a real candidate rather than a silent fallback. When automatic capture or refinement fails, return typed diagnostics containing executed work, phase timings, candidate failures, and the last valid checkpoint so benchmark rows never encode performed work as zero. Add JVM and Scala.js cases for adequate identity, capture-required displacement, insufficient information, and exhausted candidate refinement. Preserve one audit after final model selection and leave preset thresholds unchanged. Opened L23 inputs remain development-only; fresh sealed accuracy and exact cost follow this task.
set.title: FA-L26: Complete automatic identity eligibility and failed-run evidence
